#pragma warning disable MAAI001 // Pinned MAF 1.26.0 keyed session registrations are checked through their public APIs.
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text.Json;
using AGUI.Abstractions;
using Hashbrown.AspNetCore;
using Microsoft.Agents.AI;
using Microsoft.Agents.AI.Hosting.AGUI.AspNetCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

static void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) throw new Exception(message); }
var baseline = new ServiceCollection();
HashbrownEndpointConfiguration.Configure(baseline);
var expectedOptions = baseline.Count(service => service.ServiceType == typeof(IConfigureOptions<Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Json.JsonOptions>));
var failures = new List<string>();
foreach (var scenario in new[] { "shared twice", "shared then native", "two native registrations" })
{
    try
    {
        var builder = WebApplication.CreateEmptyBuilder(new() { EnvironmentName = "Production", ContentRootPath = AppContext.BaseDirectory });
        builder.WebHost.UseKestrel().UseUrls("http://127.0.0.1:0");
        builder.Logging.ClearProviders(); builder.Services.AddRouting();
        builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options => options.AddPolicy("native", policy => policy.RequireAuthenticatedUser()));
        var catalog = new NativeToolCatalog([]);
        var names = scenario == "shared twice" ? Array.Empty<string>() : scenario == "shared then native" ? new[] { "first" } : new[] { "first", "second" };
        if (scenario != "two native registrations") HashbrownEndpointConfiguration.Configure(builder.Services);
        if (scenario == "shared twice") HashbrownEndpointConfiguration.Configure(builder.Services);
        foreach (var name in names)
            NativeSessionEndpointConfiguration.Configure(builder.Services, name, new RegistrationJournal(), catalog, _ => "registration-scope");
        await using var app = builder.Build();
        var options = app.Services.GetRequiredService<IOptions<Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Json.JsonOptions>>().Value.SerializerOptions;
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize<AIContent>(new InterruptRequestContent("request") { Reason = "fixture", Message = "input needed" }, options);
        Check(JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AIContent>(json, options) is InterruptRequestContent { RequestId: "request" }, "Actual interrupt polymorphism must round-trip after repeated configuration.");
        Check(builder.Services.Count(service => service.ServiceType == typeof(IConfigureOptions<Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Json.JsonOptions>)) == expectedOptions, "Repeated composition must not add duplicate shared JSON option actions.");
        app.Use(async (context, next) =>
        {
            context.User = new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity([new Claim("sub", "registration-user")], "fixture"));
            await next(context);
        });
        app.UseAuthorization();
        if (names.Length == 0) app.MapAGUIServer("/run", new RegistrationModel().AsAIAgent(name: "stateless"));
        else
        {
            var accessor = app.Services.GetRequiredService<IHttpContextAccessor>();
            foreach (var name in names)
            {
                _ = app.Services.GetRequiredKeyedService<AgentSessionStore>(name);
                NativeSessionEndpointConfiguration.Map(app, "/" + name, NativeSessionAgentFactory.Create(new RegistrationModel(), name, [], catalog, accessor), "native");
            }
            if (names.Length == 2)
                Check(!ReferenceEquals(app.Services.GetRequiredKeyedService<AgentSessionStore>(names[0]), app.Services.GetRequiredKeyedService<AgentSessionStore>(names[1])), "Distinct named native stores must retain their registrations.");
        }
        await app.StartAsync();
        using var http = new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri(app.Urls.Single()), Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10) };
        foreach (var route in names.Length == 0 ? new[] { "run" } : names)
        {
            using var response = await http.PostAsJsonAsync("/" + route, new { threadId = "thread", runId = "run", messages = new[] { new { id = "user", role = "user", content = "hello" } }, tools = Array.Empty<object>(), context = Array.Empty<object>(), state = new { } });
            var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            Check(response.IsSuccessStatusCode && body.Contains("RUN_FINISHED") && !body.Contains("RUN_ERROR"), "Actual native hosting must serialize its updates after repeated configuration: " + scenario + ": " + body);
        }
        await app.StopAsync();
    }
    catch (Exception exception) { failures.Add(scenario + ": " + exception.GetType().Name + ": " + exception.Message); }
}
if (failures.Count != 0) throw new Exception(string.Join(Environment.NewLine, failures));
Console.WriteLine("Endpoint registration contracts passed.");

sealed class RegistrationModel : IChatClient
{
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) => Task.FromResult(new ChatResponse(new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Assistant, "done") { MessageId = "message" }) { ResponseId = "message" });
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    { foreach (var update in (await GetResponseAsync(messages, options, cancellationToken)).ToChatResponseUpdates()) yield return update; }
    public object? GetService(Type type, object? key = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}
sealed class RegistrationJournal : INativeSessionJournal
{
    public ValueTask InitializeAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    public ValueTask<NativeSessionAdmission> TryAcquireAsync(NativeSessionKey key, string request, CancellationToken ct = default) => ValueTask.FromResult(new NativeSessionAdmission(200, new(key, "token", 1, 1), IsNew: true));
    public ValueTask<bool> CaptureModelCallAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeToolCall call, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public ValueTask<bool> CaptureApprovalBatchAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeApprovalBatch capture, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException("Registration-only journal has no approval authority.");
    public ValueTask<NativeApprovalEvidence?> GetOwnedApprovalEvidenceAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException("Registration-only journal has no approval authority.");
    public ValueTask<bool> TryAdmitApprovalBatchAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, string batchId, NativeApprovalAdmissionEnvelope admission, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException("Registration-only journal has no approval authority.");
    public ValueTask<bool> SettleApprovalRejectionAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeApprovalRejection rejection, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException("Registration-only journal has no approval authority.");
    public ValueTask<bool> SettleBrowserBypassResultAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, string batchId, string requestId, string callId, JsonElement result, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException("Registration-only journal has no approval authority.");
    public ValueTask<NativeToolCall?> GetOwnedCallAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, string id, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public ValueTask<bool> TryStartDispatchAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeToolCall call, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public ValueTask<bool> CompleteDispatchAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeToolCall call, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public ValueTask<bool> RenewAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, CancellationToken ct = default) => ValueTask.FromResult(true);
    public ValueTask<NativeSavedReceipt?> SaveAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, NativeSessionSave save, CancellationToken ct = default) => ValueTask.FromResult<NativeSavedReceipt?>(new(lease, 2));
    public ValueTask<bool> AuthorizePublicationAsync(NativeSavedReceipt receipt, CancellationToken ct = default) => ValueTask.FromResult(true);
    public ValueTask<bool> FinalizePublicationAsync(NativeSavedReceipt receipt, CancellationToken ct = default) => ValueTask.FromResult(true);
    public ValueTask<bool> FailureCleanupAsync(NativeSessionLease lease, CancellationToken ct = default) => ValueTask.FromResult(true);
    public ValueTask<NativeSessionStatus> ReadStatusAsync(NativeSessionKey key, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public ValueTask<NativeSessionInspection?> InspectAsync(IReadOnlySet<string> scopes, NativeSessionKey key, int limit = 50, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public ValueTask<int> ReconcileAsync(IReadOnlySet<string> scopes, NativeSessionKey key, string actor, NativeSessionReconciliation request, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public ValueTask<int> RetireAsync(IReadOnlySet<string> scopes, NativeSessionKey key, string actor, NativeSessionReconciliation request, CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public ValueTask<int> MaintainAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) => throw new NotSupportedException();
}
